notes.title: NEW CONTENT????1?
notes.content:
We've added in 30 new achievements for you to collect throughout the game. Earn the envy of your friends, make your enemies fume with jealousy, and win the love of random people on the internet by collecting them all (results may vary). 

[b]The Backslash Games dev team would also like to pass along a thank you to our community:[/b]

"Backslash games was founded in 2019 by four college students, Josh, Sophie, Ja'ire, and Will, to pursue our capstone project. When we started along this path, we could never have dreamed that five years later we would still have players to push updates to, but thanks to you, we do.

As devs, all we want is for people to have fun with the things we make. Being able to put our work out into the world and not only have people play it, but like it, is a truly amazing feeling we are all lucky to experience. 

From everyone here at Backslash, thank you for playing our game. There are hundreds of thousands of indie games out there and you chose to buy ours, and for that we are eternally grateful."

notes.title: Kakatte Koi Yo! Live Stream
notes.content: Art Lead Ja'ire Vaughn and Designer Will Rossi will be streaming Kakatte Koi Yo! at 7PM CST on Saturday, November 14th. Viewers can join the battle through remote play and talk to the developers.
